title: RAPH SEVEN II - Riva Corsaro 100
highlights: Master suite, three doubles and one single
Panoramic interior with abundant natural light
description:
RAPH SEVEN II is a 30-metre Riva Corsaro 100, conceived to bring the qualities of a maxi-yacht to a flybridge just under the 30-metre limit. She accommodates up to ten guests in a master suite, three double cabins and one single.

Her interior is designed for uninterrupted sea views and abundant natural light, with the attention to detail synonymous with Riva. Price and location on request.
